hyperparameters.method: Logistic recalibration of the hurdle logit + status dummies fitted on 2025-26 games before 2026-01-15, scored on later games (chronological, within the holdout season; nothing else tuned).

hypothesis: Report status (OUT/DOUBTFUL/QUESTIONABLE) sharply separates who plays.
limitations: The injury report is the decisive participation input; the forward projector uses it.

point.result: Brier 0.1320 -> 0.0868 (-0.0452 (95% CI -0.0486 to -0.0416)); unconditional minutes MAE 6.271 -> 4.701 (-1.570 (95% CI -1.665 to -1.471)). OUT/DOUBTFUL precision for absence 0.816, recall 0.743.

question: How much does the archived official injury report add to participation and unconditional minutes?
